source_prompt:
I want you to launch at least three subagents in the background, all in parallel:
1. One subagent: "Hey, subagent! I want you to read agent.md."
2. Second subagent: "Use agent.md on two or three more files using Agentic View and also read and also trigger Agentic and also trigger Normal View function to view it. So, Agentic View or Normal View."
3. Third subagent: "Tell third subagent to use terminal, use background terminal. Third subagent will use background terminal to solve complex problems. Not to solve complex problems, third subagent uses background terminal, just that guaranteed output."
After reading that, I want you to launch at least 100 terminals in the background, 100 terminals in the background, with each with "go build" as the input. So now, termy and then synthesize the result if any tool calling error fails.
